description:
The food.gdt dataset is loaded in Gretl (containing weekly food expenditure and income for 40 households). Your task is to perform a structural break test.

1. Open the Gretl console (Tools > Gretl console) or a new script (File > Script files > New script).
2. Run an OLS regression of 'food_exp' (dependent) on 'income' (independent).
3. Perform a Chow test for a structural break at observation 20.
4. Save the complete output (including regression results and the Chow test result) to a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/chow_test_results.txt'.

Hint: You can use the 'outfile' command in a script to redirect output, or copy-paste the output from the console/window to a text file.
